_comment: Every path is TOOL, FIXTURE or DATA under Skill Repo Spec section 9.
TOOL is public code, documentation and metrics about the tool itself.
FIXTURE contains only synthetic inputs and examples produced by tools/make_fixtures.py.
DATA is actual run output and research observations in a versioned PRIVATE companion.
The public tool has no in-repository DATA fallback. guards/tools/datadir.py resolves storage.
guards/tools/data_boundary.py enforces declared boundaries in hooks and CI.
_tool_note: The former yield replay records are generated FIXTURE entries; no runtime-shaped record needs a TOOL exception.
_fixture_note: Declared fixture artifacts and the migrated story, provider, score, collection and temporal scenarios are generated by tools/make_fixtures.py. Provider names describe parser contracts; scenario identities, amounts, observations and histories are synthetic.
_fixture_backlog: Source12 moves the residual weight-regression, provider-observation, distinct-subject, gap-accounting and worked collection scenarios into fresh builders or a declared generated document. Tiny malformed containers, lexical literals and small structural setup helpers are outside this substantial-scenario inventory.
_audited: Runtime source plans, pull and collection receipts, opportunities, digests, dedup state, roster consumption, source-health reports, completeness reports, wrapper logs and identity sweeps are DATA in the separate PRIVATE companion. Each write target uses the shared Guards proof API with local Git metadata and a fresh PRIVATE visibility receipt. Public, unknown, unversioned and own-tool targets fail closed. Reads may remain uninitialized; writers never invent a fallback.
_armed: Pinned guard tests and data-boundary checks remain required. The consumer adapter binds only its privately loaded resolver instance to the canonical repository root, including linked worktrees; pinned kit files remain unchanged.
_dependencies: Git and a fresh PRIVATE visibility receipt are required for writes; the shared proof performs no authentication or network request. The pinned datadir resolver remains the discovery authority. A scoped consumer-root adapter handles its linked-worktree limitation; the shared-kit followup is recorded in private implementation evidence.
_data_home: DAILY_HOTSPOTS_CONFIG or DAILY_HOTSPOTS_DATA_DIR selects the companion through pinned guards. Explicit archive and roster destinations must also belong to a separately verified PRIVATE GitHub repository.
